policy: For each clip and E/F fusion independently, try S24/S20/S16/S12 with fixed B4 T5. Choose the first complete file strictly below that clip base bytes. Use byte counts only; no per-clip metric or ROI choices.
reason: video2 uses almost every fine-grid motion node, so dropping unused nodes alone does not meet the preferred below-base target.
fallback_if_none: do not approve a candidate; report failure, base-only is available
